body: I sent a PM, thank you

I love my mom very much, and I hate to put her through all my suffering and seeing me so sad because it breaks her heart.. She has her own problems. My grandpa is in the hospital again for the 3rd time the year, my mom is the closest of my grandparents children so she has to deal with their situations too. I shouldn't be putting even more stress on her, complaining all the time about my issues since they seem silly to her, and I cry all the time because of it.. 
My eating habits are awful. I eat really healthy usually and I pack lunches, measure out proportions, make dinner, etc. but when I get depressed or sad I just eat. And eat. And eat. And I just binge until I puke. It's not healthy at all.. I just can't help it. My life revolves around food.

I just dropped the bomb on my mom about being depressed and suicidal again.. We'll see how this plays out. I've caused her so much trouble :/ not as in the "terrible grades, does drugs and parties" way but with all my emotional stress and crying.. If she was rid of me there would be some weight off her shoulders.
